_meta.purpose: Per-day room/bed rent by ward category, used to cost avoidable bed-days on the Care-Value Scorecard's Cost domain when an over-stay is flagged.
_meta.source: EHRC Tariff List — Room Rent (TARIFF 2025-26), effective 1 June 2025. perDay = TOTAL column (bed charges + nursing charges).

billingRules.dischargeTime: Official discharge by 11:00; 11:00–17:00 adds a half-day room charge; after 18:00 a full day; 0–3 h stay = half day.
billingRules.dayCare: Day care = a 4-hour slot, max 12 hours; an overnight day-care stay is billed at the relevant room category.
billingRules.roomCategoryMultiplier: Investigations, procedures, packages and consultant visits are all charged DIFFERENTIALLY by room category — a higher category inflates the whole episode, not just bed rent.
billingRules.packages: A package includes room rent, surgeon/anaesthetist/assistant fees, OT, doctor visits, medicines and consumables WITHIN the package period; any stay beyond the package period is billed separately on actuals (so only bed-days beyond the package period are avoidable extra cost).

_meta.note: Excess avoidable bed-days are gated on an auditor-flagged length-of-stay over-use; the room rate is the EHRC tariff, the avoidable-day count is the audit's judgement.
